info.title: FreeSftpSharp REST API
info.description: Administration of FreeSftpSharp. Every route needs a bearer token (POST /api/v1/token) or an API key (X-API-Key) of an administrator, except /api/v1/health and /api/v1/token. The permissions and the scope role of the administrator apply as in the admin UI. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

post.summary: A bearer token for an administrator (user name and password; the same lockout as the admin UI login).
A new bearer token for the caller of a valid one.

get.summary: Answers without login when the API runs.
The version, uptime and node of the server, and the permissions of the caller.
The audit log, newest first, with filters.
Exports every stored object. The storage and webhook secrets are in it only with a passphrase (X-Dump-Passphrase), encrypted with it.

post.summary: Imports a dump. ?mode=add (default: an existing object is an error), update (replace existing objects) or skip.

get.summary: Lists the users (in the scope of the caller), by name.

put.summary: Saves a user. Values that are not given get their defaults; the password stays unless one is given.

patch.summary: Changes some values of a user (JSON merge patch, RFC 7396).

delete.summary: Removes a user. The files in its storage stay.

post.summary: Adds keys (an authorized_keys text). A key that the user has already is skipped.

delete.summary: Removes the key with this fingerprint (?fingerprint=SHA256:...).

post.summary: Generates a key pair, adds the public key, and returns the private key once (it is not stored).

get.summary: The own quotas of the user, and the effective limits (also from its groups) with their usage.

put.summary: Sets the quotas and the bandwidth of the user; a value that is not given is not set.

post.summary: Queues a scan of the used space and files of every storage of the user with a disk quota.
Sets the uploaded and downloaded bytes of the user to 0.

get.summary: The app passwords of the user: the metadata only, never the secret.

post.summary: Creates an app password and returns its secret once; it is not stored and cannot be read again.

delete.summary: Revokes an app password: it stops working at once.

get.summary: Whether the user has a TOTP second factor, and when it was set up. Never the secret.

delete.summary: Resets the second factor of the user: the next login needs no code, and the user can set it up again.

get.summary: The registered storage providers and their options.

post.summary: Creates the storage (not saved) and lists its root.

get.summary: Lists the virtual folders (needs ManageFolders or ManageUsers).

delete.summary: Removes a folder and unmounts it from every user. The data in its storage stays.

get.summary: Whether the administrator has a TOTP second factor, and when it was set up. Never the secret.

delete.summary: Resets the second factor of another administrator (not its own: use the admin UI with a current code).
Removes a role that no user and no administrator has.

get.summary: Lists the API keys of the caller; ?all=true lists those of every administrator it manages (ManageAdmins).

post.summary: Creates an API key for the caller. The key is in the answer only, once. Needs a bearer token.

delete.summary: Revokes an API key. Needs a bearer token.

get.summary: The active auto-bans of client addresses.
The event names for the eventTypes filter.

post.summary: Puts a test event for the webhook in the outbox.

get.summary: The last deliveries of the webhook.

post.summary: Sends an asynchronous delivery again, now.

get.summary: Lists the groups (needs ManageGroups or ManageUsers).
The quotas and the bandwidth that the group gives its members.

put.summary: Sets the quotas and the bandwidth of the group; a value that is not given is not set.

get.summary: The users (in the scope of the caller) with the group as primary or secondary group.

post.summary: Adds a user to the group: as its primary group (the old primary group becomes a secondary one), or as a secondary group.

get.summary: The action types and their options.

post.summary: Runs a scheduled or on-demand rule now and returns its runs.

get.summary: The last runs of the rule.

put.summary: Saves the given settings; a value that is not given stays.

patch.summary: Saves the given settings; a value that is not given (or null) stays.
